findings.description: A right-click (or Ctrl-click on macOS) on any board button sets `pressing`, the native context menu swallows the pointerup, and the board then holds back every later push while the header still says 'live' and the held notice stays hidden.

The LIST_PAGE_ROWS JSDoc justifies 20 with claims nothing in the repo checks ("fit one laptop screen", "a backlog of usual size"), so someone tuning the constant can't tell which claim actually constrains it.

ListWindow now has one consumer, the return type of listWindow in web-dashboard.service.ts. An unexported local interface there would drop the new file and its import, which is the review note's own alternative and is outside general.md's rule for exported types.

The test comment says the filter reads row text "with the tags dropped", but the test replaces each tag with a space, while real textContent joins the spans with no separator, so the comment overstates how closely the test mirrors the page.

process_issues.description: A Grep rooted at the repository's parent directory was denied, so the guards reviewer searched only src/, scripts/ and docs/adr/. A guard test outside those directories would have been missed.
